domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 谐波频率相对于基频的整数倍数。
usage_overview: 用于标识谐波频率相对于基频的整数倍关系。在列车作用下的桥梁动力分析中，可据此辨别高次谐波，识别造成响应放大的激励来源。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P093.title: Influence of dominant frequencies and their higher harmonics on the dynamic responses of railway bridge subjected to high-speed trains
P093.authors: NK Kedia, C Ngamkhanong, Y Singh, L Xu

complete_examples.text: The results show that the occurrence of specific harmonic numbers of dominant frequencies depends on train speed and the fundamental time period of railway bridges, and a nonlinear relationship exists between harmonic number, train speed and fundamental time period of bridges.
The proposed model can be thoroughly utilised to calculate the harmonic number, which may cause amplification in the bridge response.
